overall: Committee may not rely on the Open Meeting Law to keep redacting former-superintendent talks, Unit A, and SEIU grievance minutes, but may still withhold the Unit B portion of the November 13 minutes; release ordered.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged redactions in November 13 and December 4, 2023 executive session minutes on former superintendent contract talks were improper because the matter was settled.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the above, we find that the Open Meeting Law does not justify continued nondisclosure of the discussions related to contract negotiations with the former superintendent.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged redactions of executive session minutes on collective bargaining Unit A and an SEIU Local 888 grievance were improper because those matters had concluded.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee has not met its burden in justifying the continued nondisclosure of its discussions regarding collective bargaining Unit A or the collective bargaining grievance

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged redactions of executive session minutes on collective bargaining Unit B were improper because the negotiations had concluded.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the November 13 discussions related to collective bargaining Unit B did touch upon matters that could harm the Committee’s future bargaining position if disclosed and that the Committee may therefore rely on the Open Meeting Law to continue withhold this portion of the minutes.

remedy: Release the November 13 and December 4, 2023 executive session minutes without redaction of the portions on the former superintendent contract talks, Unit A, and the SEIU Local 888 Clerical Unit grievance, unless privilege or a Public Records Law exemption allows redaction.
